methodology.environment_note: October 5 2026 local Mac; dedicated local Redis/PostgreSQL; actual AAPL/MSFT Alpaca IEX 60.2386-second measurement: 1483 events, one-second peak 141/sec; target 282/sec; live stack shares host; four partitions, two threads per consumer role, one Python benchmark process
methodology.concurrency: local threads, separate continuous engine and persistence consumers
methodology.latency_basis: event enqueue timestamp to committed PostgreSQL batch; includes queue and database time
methodology.acceptance: offered rate >=95% target; steady backlog slope <=max(1 message/s,1% target); no final backlog, duplicates, losses, or worker errors
methodology.scope: engine-only dedupe and local continuous pipeline are separate checks; not production-machine scaling

infrastructure.postgresql: PostgreSQL 16.15 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
